Description
 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior React Developer & Team Leader to play a pivotal role in maintaining and elevating our Frontend architecture, while guiding and inspiring our engineering team. Our platform is a financial SaaS featuring a complex UI driven by heavy data manipulation, dynamic charts, custom canvases, and highly interactive tables.
We need a visionary engineer who writes clean, hyper-optimized code, holds a proven track record of leading software development teams, and possesses the patience, strategic mindset, and passion to mentor junior and mid-level peers while driving technical excellence.
 Requirements
 What We Are Looking For
Experience: 5+ years of proven track record developing complex, large-scale web applications (SPA/SaaS).
Proven leadership experience as a Team Leader or Engineering Lead, with a demonstrated history of successfully managing, guiding, and scaling software engineering teams.
Technical Expertise: Deep mastery of React, state management, and performance optimization for heavy data structures and interactive UI elements.
State Management: Impeccable understanding of both global and local state management patterns (Redux, Zustand, Context API, etc.).
Performance Engineering: Demonstrated track record of delivering complex, data-heavy web applications from architectural design to production. Demonstrated experience optimizing large-scale React apps using useMemo, useCallback, and list/table virtualization.
Quality Focus: A strong commitment to writing highly testable code, backed by experience with frontend testing frameworks (Jest, Cypress, React Testing Library).
AI-Assisted Development: Ability to work “agentically”—leveraging modern AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, etc.) to accelerate delivery, explore technical solutions, and optimize workflows, while rigorously maintaining code quality and security.
Soft Skills: Outstanding communication skills, technical leadership capabilities, and a proactive mindset toward tackling technical debt.
Job responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
Architecture & Implementation: Design and build complex UI features, including custom canvas modules, massive data tables, and probabilistic charts.
Performance Optimization: Drive extreme application performance tuning, focusing on efficient state management and eliminating unnecessary re-renders.
Technical Leadership: Provide rigorous code reviews and mentorship for junior and mid-level developers through pair programming and establishing coding standards.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Engage in the “Three Amigos” process with Business Analysts and QA to ensure business logic is perfectly mapped to the UI before engineering begins.
Tooling & Infrastructure: Actively participate in tooling decisions, such as optimizing Vite configurations, driving migrations, and managing dependencies.
Leading: Lead, mentor, and scale a team of frontend engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and clean code.
Balance hands-on architectural design with team management, code reviews, and resource planning.
Oversee the evolution of our complex financial SaaS Frontend architecture.
What we offer
 Empowering Projects: With 500+ clients spanning diverse industries and domains, we provide an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies. As a team, we engineer digital products that positively impact people’s lives.
 Empowering Growth: We foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development. Our dedication is to provide timely and comprehensive assistance for every consultant through our dedicated Learning & Development team, ensuring their continuous growth and success.
 DE&I Matters: At GlobalLogic, we deeply value and embrace diversity . We are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, fostering an inclusive and empowering work environment.
 Career Development: Our corporate culture places a strong emphasis on career development, offering abundant opportunities for growth. Regular interactions with our teams ensure their engagement, motivation, and recognition. We empower our team members to pursue their career goals with confidence and enthusiasm.
 Comprehensive Benefits: In addition to equitable compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes the overall well-being of our consultants. We genuinely care about their health and strive to create a positive work environment.
 Flexible Opportunities: At GlobalLogic, we prioritize work-life balance by offering flexible opportunities tailored to your lifestyle. Explore relocation and rotation options for diverse cultural and professional experiences in different countries with our company.
 About GlobalLogic
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.
